label: D1 after rewarded a1->S1 common trial; stronger with S1 belief and late in episode
short_terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * belief ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * (ep_dec >= 8) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * ep_dec
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 r") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * ep_dec ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * (tv("action", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * belief_cover ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * (belief > 0.5)
explanation: Silent at GO and D2; at D1 it is essentially gated on the previous trial being a1 to S1 (common) rewarded (residual +0.175 vs about -0.065 for every other pattern). Within that gate, magnitude grows with the ideal-observer belief that S1 is good and is much larger late in the episode (last two deciles, activations near 1 at trials 90-99), beyond the timing baseline. The free fit adds the trial before (reward/choice two trials back), belief_cover and a belief>0.5 step, gaining only a few points (dev 0.34 vs 0.30 short); the observed-only additive ceiling is 0.36 and the all-cue ceiling 0.42, so much of the remaining variance (which a1-S1-r D1 steps fire strongly) is not captured by observed history; the earlier firing pass tied it to the model own a1 policy, which is excluded here.
